dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing me here. It's so peaceful — the perfect place to meditate.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Though there's nothing I really need to think about right now... I might end up nodding off.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: But don't worry, I'll just have to think of something worth thinking about instead...
